summary: Hinged arm on a clevis base with a Ø8 pin
assumptions: Arm 22 wide between lugs 24 apart: 1 mm side clearance each side.

parts.name: Clevis base
parts.description: Clevis base: plate 80 x 40 x 8 with two lugs 8 thick, 24 apart, a Ø8 H7 pin bore through both lugs 24 mm above the underside, and two Ø6.6 fixing holes.

parts.name: Hinge arm
parts.description: Arm 100 x 22 x 12 with a Ø8 pivot bore at one end and a Ø8.4 hole 90 mm from the pivot.

parts.name: Hinge pin
parts.description: Dowel pin Ø8 x 40 through both lugs and the arm.
